contexts.text: The bars of the earth (). AE 538:11, Explained.
Thou shalt make staves of Shittim wood () = power thence. Staves = the power which is of truth from good. AC 9541. AC 9662.
For the staves relate to the arms in man, and therefore have a similar signification... Thus staves = power.
As the staves with which the ark was carried = power, so also did the bars with which the gates of cities were fastened. Illustrated.
(In these passages) staves = the power which is of truth from good.
The staves shall be in the rings of the ark () = that power shall remain steadfast from the Divine sphere of good and truth. AC 9502. AC 9735.
Thou shalt make staves for the altar () = the power of holding together in a state of good. Explained.
For receptacles for the staves () = the power of truth from good there. Staves = the power of truth from good.
Thou shalt make staves of Shittim wood () = power from the good of love of the Lord.
To cast down their bars () = their principles of falsity. Bars = principles of falsity.
The staves with which the ark was carried = Divine power; the same as arms.
